model: Elo with FiveThirtyEight's rule for NBA games and a home court of 40 points
provenance: The starting point is each team's last rating in FiveThirtyEight's NBA Elo file (nba_elo.csv), which ends with the finals of June 2023. FiveThirtyEight published its data under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0).

Those ratings were carried through the 3,962 games of 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 with the rule in elo.py and the constants above, giving up 25% of their distance to 1505 before each of the three seasons.
The ratings below are the result after one more such step, for the start of 2026-27, rounded to whole numbers.
The results of those three seasons are not in this repository.
